                @TheValueist @Super_Powers_AI Hey Super, build an interactive AI Memory Hierarchy & Hardware Infrastructure Simulator that models memory capacity, bandwidth, and latency bottlenecks across GPU HBM, server DDR5 DRAM, CXL memory expansion, and enterprise NVMe SSDs for scaling AI inference and local fallback workloads.

Users can adjust model parameters, quantization precision (FP16/FP8/INT8/INT4), context window length, batch size, and topology bandwidths (HBM, CXL/DDR5, PCIe eSSD). The simulator calculates exact weight memory, KV-cache sizing, interconnect saturation percentages, tier spilling, and tokens-per-second ceilings, updating a D3.js memory flow diagram and hardware topology bottleneck inspector in real time.

The tool features pre-populated workload presets (Llama-3 70B Serve, MoE Parameter Offload, Edge Local Fallback) for instant friction-free exploration, a complete trade-off matrix, and downloadable JSON/CSV infrastructure specifications. Built with a dark industrial terminal theme, high-contrast neon accents, and full responsive support for mobile and desktop viewports.
